name: Runner Extras - Task Scheduler OOS
brief: Issue #2866: TaskScheduler.TaskExists and TaskScheduler.CancelTask reached BC's real scheduler data layer and died with a NullReferenceException out of NavSqlConnectionScope / ALCancelTaskAsync. Background job scheduling is permanently out of scope (docs/scope.md#jobs), so both now refuse by name with the out-of-scope signal. This suite pins that refusal and its scope: CanCreateTask still answers false without throwing, and CreateTask / SetTaskReady still get BC's OWN 'You do not have permission to create or run scheduled tasks.' rather than the runner's refusal.
description: Every claim here is runner-specific by construction — which surface the runner refuses, under which name, and which surfaces it must NOT take over from BC. The plain-BC half of this surface (CreateTask returning a real task id on a service tier) is upstream in the al-language corpus as TestTaskSchedulerCloudBehavior.al, classified here as an intended divergence in tests/expectations/divergence-session.json.
